statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, vals(r) is exactly the concatenation of three sequences: (vals(list1)[0], ..., vals(list1)[a-1]), then (vals(list2)[0], ..., vals(list2)[len(list2)-1]), then (vals(list1)[b+1], ..., vals(list1)[len(list1)-1]). Equivalently, len(r) = a + len(list2) + (len(list1) - b - 1), and for every integer i with 0 <= i < len(r): if 0 <= i < a then vals(r)[i] = vals(list1)[i]; if a <= i < a + len(list2) then vals(r)[i] = vals(list2)[i - a]; if a + len(list2) <= i < len(r) then vals(r)[i] = vals(list1)[b + 1 + (i - a - len(list2))].
preconditions: Let len(L) be the number of nodes in a List L and vals(L) the sequence of its node values from head to tail. The inputs satisfy 3 <= len(list1) <= 10^4, 1 <= len(list2) <= 10^4, and 1 <= a <= b < len(list1) - 1, where a and b are interpreted as mathematical integers and indices are 0-based.
